what: Full-height Hero: the photo slowly settles from 1.05x to its normal size over 12s ease-out, the center text group rises after .3s from 20px below and transparent over 1.2s, and after 1.2s a vertical SCROLL line (1px · 40px) appears at the bottom center and repeatedly shrinks to half length and darkens every 2s before returning

options.--fx-rise · --fx-delay · --fx-cue-delay: Text rise duration · text delay · scroll line delay (css variables), default 1.2s · .3s · 1.2s
options.--fx-beat: One beat of the line shrinking and returning (css variable), default 2s
options.[data-fx-part=cue]: (if present) scroll hint at bottom center — inside it [data-fx-part=line] and text

note: Since it is a CSS-only part, it applies as is to late-arriving elements. The original keyframes (slowZoom·fadeUp·scrollLine) were rewritten with the same values

from.where: lookbook.html hero (.sv-ghero — original gallery page .hero-bg slowZoom 12s · .hero-content fadeUp 1.2s .3s · .hero-scroll-line scrollLine 2s)
